sourceText: 在导出的视频以及导出视频的界面上加上 Proof-or-stop ，这样用户在看到这些内容的时候至少知道这个是 Proof-or-stop
normalizedOutcome: Viewers see Proof-or-stop on the playback export interface and in exported video frames.
acceptanceClaim: The playback title and exported frame title visibly identify Proof-or-stop while preserving story identity.
